name: Huawei Liaoning Region (Jinzhou) Cloud Computing Data Center
notes: Chinese IDCQuan/Sohu report says the Huawei Liaoning regional cloud data center is in Jinzhou University Science Park, originated from a 2017 Jinzhou-Huawei agreement, with 21,000 sqm floor area, 834 8 kW cabinets and capacity for more than 15,000 servers; status inferred operational from site visit/build-out wording.

name: China Mobile (Shenyang) Data Center
notes: People's Daily Liaoning reports China Mobile (Shenyang) Data Center has two campuses in the EU Industrial Park and Daoyi Economic Development Zone, total site area 183,000 sqm; CCTIME says it was selected as a 2021 national new data center typical case.

name: China Unicom SHE1
notes: Inflect lists China Unicom SHE1 as an operating data center at 2 Kun Shan Zhong Lu 43 Xiang, Shenyang, Liaoning.

name: China Unicom SHE2
notes: Inflect lists China Unicom SHE2 at 84 Huanghebeida St, Shenyang; Data Center Map page for the same address describes Shenyang-2 facility specifications.

name: Zenlayer SHE1
notes: Inflect lists Zenlayer SHE1 at 2 Kun Shan Zhong Lu 43 Xiang; Zenlayer announced multiple mainland China data center locations including Shenyang.

name: Zenlayer SHE2 / Shenyang-2 Data Center
notes: Data Center Map lists Zenlayer Shenyang-2 at 84 Huanghebeida St with 1,000 sqm area, 99.999%+ power SLA, 2.4 kVA per cabinet and N+1 UPS; Inflect also lists Zenlayer SHE2 in Shenyang.

name: Liaoning Unicom Shenyang-Fushun Intelligent Computing Center and AI Center
notes: Sina/Operator Finance reports Liaoning Unicom planned an intelligent computing center and AI center in the Shenyang-Fushun Demonstration Zone with about RMB 1.4 billion total investment, 102 mu land area and 77,600 sqm building area; local government notice records strategic cooperation around a high-spec IDC/data-center project.

name: China Mobile Tieling (Qinghe) Data Center
notes: Liaoshen Evening News report on China Mobile Liaoning says the Tieling (Qinghe) data center was included in MIIT's high-quality big data center enterprise case collection and positioned as a zero-carbon data center benchmark.

name: Shizuishan Western Spatiotemporal Information Data Center Project
developer: Shizuishan / Northwest Geographic Information Industrial Park partners
notes: Ningxia Department of Commerce investment PDF names the project, locates it in Dawukou District's Northwest Geographic Information Industrial Park, and gives planned land area of 180 mu and total building area of 168,000 sqm.

name: Yinchuan Intelligent Computing Center Project
developer: Yinchuan municipal/Suyin Industrial Park project partners
notes: China Daily reports Yinchuan signed first batch 'computing capital' projects; the intelligent computing center project expects RMB 10 billion total investment, will revitalize Suyin Industrial Park Big Data Center phase II, operate and lease/sell computing racks.

name: Suyin AI Super Cluster / Artificial Intelligence Innovation Empowerment Center
developer: Yinchuan municipal/Suyin Industrial Park project partners
notes: Same China Daily report says the RMB 400 million AI innovation empowerment center is expected to form a Suyin AI super cluster with more than 1000P of computing power.

name: ZTE Smart Yinchuan Big Data Center
developer: Yinchuan Bintou Big Data Center Co., Ltd. / ZTE Smart City partners
notes: Official first-batch National Green Data Center list includes 'ZTE Smart Yinchuan Big Data Center' in Ningxia, applicant Yinchuan Bintou Big Data Center Co., Ltd., internet sector; operational inferred from inclusion in national green data center list.
